---
pagetitle: "Insights"
description: "Análises de economia, mercado imobiliário e dados, publicadas com o código que as gerou."
page-layout: full
toc: false
listing:
  # Multiple listings: the split is by metadata (featured), not by position —
  # Quarto listings have no offset, so a post is promoted by setting
  # `featured: "true"` in its own front matter.
  - id: destaque
    contents: posts
    include:
      featured: "true"
    sort: "date desc"
    type: custom
    template: destaque-template.ejs
    fields: [title, date, description, categories, image]
    date-format: "MMM/YYYY"

  - id: grade
    contents: posts
    exclude:
      featured: "true"
    sort: "date desc"
    type: custom
    template: grade-template.ejs
    # No max-items: with the archive retired this listing is the full index.
    fields: [title, date, description, categories, image]
    date-format: "MMM/YYYY"
format:
  html:
    # No equations on this page; the default pulls in ~1.3 MB of MathJax.
    html-math-method: plain
---
